_comment: Ground truth, hand-verified. Committed deliberately, along with the fixtures.
The predecessor system's eval harness was well designed and unreproducible,
because .gitignore excluded *.pdf and the metrics files -- so 20 approved
labels referenced fixtures nobody had. A result that cannot be reproduced from

simple-invoice.pdf.notes: Deliberately minimal: 11 lines, one line item, no tables. Its job is to be a document that any model should get completely right, so that a failure here is unambiguous.
